Both writers perform owned temporary cleanup in an inner finally and suppress only cleanup OSError. Expected primary exceptions reach their original outer handling: XrayError with the primary exception chained for FilePublisher; PytestWarning and INTERNAL_ERROR for CaseReportPlugin. Secondary cleanup errors append the owned temporary path without serializing report contents into the diagnostic. KeyboardInterrupt is not broadly caught or converted; cleanup still runs.

Successful os.replace immediately clears temporary ownership, preventing a subsequent unlink of the consumed name. Failed writes/replacements leave the existing destination untouched. Failure before temporary creation performs no unlink. FilePublisher still creates missing parent directories; CaseReportPlugin still requires its parent to exist.

Case-report cleanup occurs before warning emission, so warning-as-error cannot interrupt cleanup or mask the primary diagnostic with cleanup OSError. Its existing unconditional INTERNAL_ERROR assignment remains unchanged. XrayPlugin continues preserving existing nonzero session status and changes only an otherwise successful session to INTERNAL_ERROR after publishing failure.

Full-report archival uses FilePublisher inside bound_comments before publisher.publish. Archive failure therefore prevents upload through the existing XrayError boundary. CaseReportPlugin retains trylast session-finish ordering: its local report can fail after an upload has already occurred; this change does not imply upload rollback or pre-upload gating.
